parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application group.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: SearchKeywords
parameters.description:
The keywords that are used to search for the event.

*   If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a and b, set the value to a and b.
*   If you need to query the custom event whose content contains a or b, set the value to a or b.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-custom-event-attribute --name test123 --event-id 1230000 --group-id 1230000 --search-keywords cms --start-time 1552224365971 --end-time 1552227965971 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeCustomEventAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --EndTime 1552227965971 --PageSize 50 --PageNumber 1 --StartTime 1552224365971 --EventId 1230000 --SearchKeywords cms --Name test123 --GroupId 1230000
